name: GitHub Actions
summary: Mention @claude in an issue or pull request and Claude Code does the work in a GitHub workflow.
what: The Claude Code GitHub Action runs Claude in your repository's workflows. Mention @claude in a comment and it can answer, implement changes and push commits or open a pull request. With a prompt, it can also run on any GitHub event or schedule.

impact.title: Issues to pull requests
impact.detail: Turn a described issue into a ready change.

impact.title: Fix from a comment
impact.detail: Ask for a fix right where the problem is discussed.

impact.title: Automate chores
impact.detail: Run recurring tasks on a schedule.

howItWorks: Run /install-github-app in Claude Code for the quick setup.
Or install the Claude GitHub App, add an API key or token secret, and add the example workflow.
Mention @claude in an issue or PR comment to start it.
Pass options like model and allowed tools through claude_args.
Runs use GitHub Actions minutes plus your API or plan usage.
